identity.tone: Calculated Risk, Insider Knowledge, High-Octane Precision
identity.aesthetic: Dark Mode Sports Analytics (Neon on Slate)
core_principles: Data is Art: Visualize odds and probabilities as the hero.
Speed & Motion: Use tickers and live updates to create urgency.
High Contrast: Neon Green for Wins, Electric Blue for AI, Warning Orange for Hot Picks.
Asymmetry: Use Bento grids to break the monotony of standard SaaS layouts.

scale.h1: text-5xl md:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase leading-[0.9]
scale.caption: text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-500

rules: Use ALL CAPS for top-level headers to create impact.
Use 'tracking-tighter' on large text to make it feel dense and solid.
Use 'text-slate-400' for body text to reduce eye strain against the dark background.

buttons.primary: bg-emerald-500 text-slate-950 hover:bg-emerald-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wide px-8 py-4 rounded-none skew-x-[-10deg] transition-all hover:scale-105
buttons.secondary: bg-slate-800 text-white hover:bg-slate-700 font-bold uppercase tracking-wide px-8 py-4 rounded-none skew-x-[-10deg] border border-slate-700
buttons.outline: border border-slate-700 text-slate-300 hover:border-emerald-500 hover:text-emerald-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wide px-8 py-4 rounded-none transition-colors

cards.feature: group relative overflow-hidden bg-slate-900/50 border border-slate-800 p-8 hover:border-emerald-500/50 transition-all duration-300
cards.stat: bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 p-6 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center
cards.bet_slip: bg-white text-slate-950 p-6 shadow-2xl rotate-[-2deg] hover:rotate-0 transition-transform duration-300

badges.live: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-red-900/50 text-red-400 animate-pulse
badges.ai: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-violet-900/50 text-violet-400 border border-violet-800
badges.win: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-emerald-900/50 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-800

images.description: Atmospheric stadium night shot for hero background overlay. Use with low opacity.
Data charts on a screen, use for the 'AI Analytics' feature section.
Confident bettor holding basketball, use for testimonial.
Excited winner, use for 'Big Wins' section.

hero.layout: Full viewport height (min-h-screen). Background image with heavy dark overlay.
hero.content: Headline: 'BEAT THE BOOKS WITH AI PRECISION'. Subhead: 'Data-driven picks, real-time odds, and a community of winners.' CTA: 'Start Winning Now'.
hero.visual: A massive, glowing 'Win Probability' gauge or a floating 'Bet Slip' component that animates.

ticker.style: Infinite horizontal scroll. Black background, bright green text for wins, white for stats.
ticker.content: Live user wins, latest big hits, confident picks.

features_bento.layout: 3-column grid. Large 'Bet of the Day' card (span 2), tall 'Leaderboard' card (span 1, row 2), small 'AI Parlay' card.

social_proof.layout: Masonry grid of 'Winning Slips' (images/components of actual bets won).

pricing.highlight: Pro Plan ($5/mo). Make it stand out with a glowing Emerald border.

footer.style: Minimal. 'Made for Winners'. Links to T&C, Responsible Gambling (Crucial for betting sites).

accessibility_rules: Ensure all text on image backgrounds has a solid text-shadow or heavy overlay.
Green/Red indicators must have accompanying icons or text labels (Win/Loss) for colorblind users.
Interactive elements must have a visible focus state (ring-2 ring-emerald-500).
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. BACKUP: Rename the existing 'Landing.js' to 'LandingOld.js' before creating the new one. Add a button in the Footer of the new design (hidden or small) to 'Switch to Classic View' that navigates to a route rendering the old component if needed.
2. PACKAGES: Install 'framer-motion' and 'recharts' if not present for animations and charts. Use 'lucide-react' for icons.
3. IMPLEMENTATION: Build the 'Hero' section first. It needs to sell the 'vibe' immediately.
4. COMPONENTS: Do not use default Shadcn cards. Create a custom 'GlassCard' component: 'bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800 backdrop-blur-md'.
5. ROUTING: Ensure the main '/' route points to the new Landing page.
6. DATA: Mock the data for the 'Live Ticker' and 'Leaderboard' for now, but structure it so it can be easily swapped for real API data.

do_not: Do NOT use gradients on text unless it's a very subtle shine.
Do NOT use 'Inter' font. Use 'Manrope' for body.
Do NOT center everything. Use left alignment for headlines to create a strong reading line.
do: DO use 'skew-x-[-10deg]' on buttons for a dynamic, fast look.
DO use noise textures in the background (opacity 5%) to reduce banding and add grit.
DO ensure the 'Login/Signup' buttons are always visible in a sticky header.
